Format.description: The file's format name; first key of the file.

Version.description: The format version this build writes; older versions are migrated when read.

Texture.description: The texture the frames are cut from; null draws the frames as opaque white.

Frames.description: At most 65536 frames; a frame's identity is its index.

Clips.description: At most 1024 clips, in authored order.

SpriteFrame.description: One frame of a sprite sheet: a rectangle of its texture with a pivot and 9-slice borders. Clips and sprites refer to it by its index.

Name.description: An optional label of at most 128 bytes, without control characters, unique among the frames when not empty.

Pivot.description: The point of the frame placed at its sprite's position, as a fraction of the frame's size from its top-left corner: (0.5, 0.5) is its centre, (0.5, 1) the middle of its bottom edge.

SpriteClip.description: A named animation over a sprite sheet's frames, driven by fixed-step ticks.

Name.description: The clip's name, which scripts play it by: 1 to 128 bytes without control characters, unique among the clips.

Loop.description: Whether the clip starts again after its last step; otherwise it holds its last frame.

SpriteRect.description: A frame's rectangle in its texture, in whole texels: x right and y down from the texture's top-left corner.

X.description: The texel column of the frame's left edge.

Y.description: The texel row of the frame's top edge (row 0 is the texture's top row).

Width.description: The frame's width; X + Width is at most 16384.

Height.description: The frame's height; Y + Height is at most 16384.

SpriteBorders.description: A frame's 9-slice insets in texels: the corners keep their size and the edges and the centre stretch when the frame is drawn larger. All zero: the frame is not sliced.

Left.description: The left inset; Left + Right is at most the frame's Width.

Top.description: The top inset; Top + Bottom is at most the frame's Height.

SpriteClipFrame.description: One step of a sprite clip: a frame shown for a number of fixed-step ticks.

Frame.description: The index of the frame in the sheet's Frames, from 0.

Ticks.description: How many fixed-step ticks the frame shows.
